t2.thesis: FOUR is a beaten-down, heavily shorted stock with a very large implied move, so the close-to-open drift into the print is roughly neutral to slightly positive, with the outcome driven by the Q3 guidance reaction.
reasons: BMO base rate about 55% is the starting point; the entry is the open the day before the print, so the exit open captures the full gap.
Stock is 43% below its 52w high and 12m return is -39%, with 18% short interest, so the setup is washed out and a relief rally is plausible.
Last guidance cut on Aug 6 caused a -15% open-to-open move, and EPS estimates were cut about 16% over 90 days, so expectations are low.
Implied move is 17.6% with IV at 1.79x realized vol, so the options market is pricing a big gap but with no directional skew (call-put IV spread is about 0.006).
Recent 5-day return of +11% means some of the rebound is already priced in, which tempers the upside.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether management holds or raises the reduced FY26 guidance (GRLNF $2.48-2.53B, adj. EPS $5.15-5.35) and shows organic growth and margin stabilization, including Global Blue integration.

prior.from: I3 BMO base rate 54.8%, overall validation 54.2%; software_internet cluster 54.1%

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings date (2026-11-05) is after today's date (2026-11-03), so the report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how FOUR's (Shift4 Payments) stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 2 points from 0.55 to 0.53, because the 5-day run-up of 11% and a track record of large negative gaps (2 of the last 4 prints down) offset the washed-out setup and low expectations.

theses.expected: Relief gap up as guidance is held and low expectations are cleared
theses.mechanism: Short covering and a cheap valuation (forward P/E about 6.9) amplify a modest beat
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is cut again or organic GRLNF growth decelerates

theses.expected: Gap down on another guidance trim or margin pressure
theses.mechanism: Higher interest expense, lower net income and G&A growth from the acquisition drag on earnings quality
theses.wrong_if: Adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow conversion beat and guidance is reaffirmed

theses.expected: Muted drift with direction set by the broader market and payments peers
theses.mechanism: The 5-day run-up already priced in some good news, so the surprise needs to be large
theses.wrong_if: There is a large surprise in either direction, which the implied move suggests is likely
